name: Saguaro National Park
policyReason: Only a few listed trails, roads and paved trails allow leashed dogs.
summary: Leashed dogs may use roads and a few paved trails such as Desert Ecology and Desert Discovery; all other trails are closed to them.

excerpts.quote: Pets are permitted on all roads and paved trails which are open to the public
Pets prohibits on all other trails

dogRules.text: Golden Gate Road (closed to cars) is a good dog walk in the west district.
Dog-friendly trails: Desert Ecology Trail (paved, 1/4 mile) and Desert Discovery Trail (paved, 0.5 mile).
Cactus Forest Loop Road is paved and dog-friendly.
Pets are prohibited on all other trails.
